x.translation:
n. 未知数
[计] 交换, 变址, 索引, 传输
x.definition: n. the 24th letter of the Roman alphabet

x-ray.translation:
a. X射线的
vt. 用X光检查, 照X光
vi. 使用X光
x-ray.definition:
v. examine by taking x-rays
v. take an x-ray of something or somebody

x-rays.translation:
[化] X射线
[医] X线, X射线, 伦琴线
x-rays.definition:
n electromagnetic radiation of short wavelength produced when high-speed electrons strike a solid target
n a radiogram made by exposing photographic film to X rays; used in medical diagnosis
v examine by taking x-rays
v take an x-ray of something or somebody

xi.translation: n. 希腊字母的第14个字母；粒子（等于xi particle）
xi.definition: n. the 14th letter of the Greek alphabet

xu.translation: n. 北越货币单位；许（姓氏）

xx.translation: abbr. 血型（xue xing, 汉语拼音）
xx.definition: n. (genetics) normal complement of sex chromosomes in a female

xxx.definition: n. (genetics) abnormal complement of three X chromosomes in a female
